ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a two-input AND gate, with inputs labeled f1 and f2; the output of this AND gate is connected to one input of the OR gate on the right. The lower input f3 is directly connected to the other input of the OR gate, and the OR gate output is labeled f. Therefore the circuit relationship is f = (f1 AND f2) OR f3. Reasoning: Let S1 = {4,5,6,7,8}, S3 = {1,6,15}, S = {1,6,8,15}. According to the AND path controlled by f1 in the circuit, a minterm that can be contributed by f2 to the output f through this path must simultaneously satisfy f=1 and f1=1. Therefore take S2 = S ∩ S1 = {1,6,8,15} ∩ {4,5,6,7,8} = {6,8}. So the canonical sum-of-minterms form of f2 is sum m(6,8).
